messages.author: a498775716638b52
messages.subject: when running setAccountInfo, Error in function (type, msg, asError = TRUE) : Could not resolve host: api.shinyapps.io
parts:
Does anyone know what leads to the following error when I try to set account info of the token before deploy the apps?

> setAccountInfo(name='<name>', token='<token>', secret='<secret>')
Error in function (type, msg, asError = TRUE)  : 
  Could not resolve host: api.shinyapps.io
Timing stopped at: 0 0 0

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: when running setAccountInfo, Error in function (type, msg, asError = TRUE) : Could not resolve host: api.shinyapps.io
parts:
On the machine that you are attempting this from, you should be able to run something like:

nslookup api.shinyapps.io
Server: 192.168.1.1
Address: 192.168.1.1#53

Non-authoritative answer:
Name: api.shinyapps.io
Address: 107.23.173.174
Name: api.shinyapps.io
Address: 34.225.63.82
Name: api.shinyapps.io
Address: 54.86.173.6

If you cannot determine the address of that host, then you should speak with your IT department or Internet provider to determine why.
